correctness.rationale: For fixed d>=2, x>0 and lambda_i>=0 with min lambda=0, checked the actual domain, volume normalization and diameter 2. The difference U-V of uniform unit-ball points is spherical with radial overlap density 2*kappa_{d-1} integral_{r/2}^1(1-s²)^((d-1)/2)ds /kappa_d². Its 2-h tail is K_d h^((d+3)/2)+O(h^((d+5)/2)); with A_t diagonal, directional scale=1-t sum lambda_i Theta_i²+O(t²) and h_t=t(x-2sum lambda_i Theta_i²)_++O(t²). Bounded derivatives give the claimed absolute O(t^(p+1)) even at positive-part transition, uniformly on bounded lambda and compact x. Strict Schur ordering follows symmetric convex expectation; strictness uses a positive-measure active angular neighborhood around at least one zero contraction direction and averaging unequal coordinates, giving unique balanced/spike endpoints. For k zero axes and q=d-k stiff directions, checked rescaling transverse sphere coordinates, beta/angular prefactor and Gamma constant (large-T limit only of coefficient, not t,T jointly). Independently verified exact d=3 two formulas match through derivatives 0..3 and have fourth-derivative jump 48/x. This is analytic all-d proof, not extrapolation from finite numeric checks.
residual_risks: No simultaneous t->0, T->infty bound is provided; the large-T asymptotic is only for fixed crossover coefficient.
